authorization.basis: The user explicitly authorized a local defensive same-target regression and PR implementation; no live or third-party system is involved.

omitted_gates.duplicate-check: This is a disclosed same-target regression and makes no novelty claim.
omitted_gates.human-review: No human reviewer participates; all severities remain internal technical assessments.

evidence_requirements.waiver_policy: Authorize an inapplicable gate before activation and record equivalent evidence.

non_success_conditions: A code smell, interface variant, rounding difference, or composed narrative without a supported attacker path and final system oracle does not count.
Separate primitive executions may not be combined into one claim unless a single compatible execution closes funding, ordering, repayment or cleanup, and impact.
Mock administrative controls, trusted-role malice, direct storage edits, production-source mutation, and unsupported dependency semantics do not count.
This revealed-target regression may not be described as blind, novel, clean-room, or an unbiased generalization measurement.
novelty_policy: No novelty claim. Compare only with the frozen committed truth after the regression submission and evidence are complete.
objective: Census every distinct reproducible vulnerability in the unchanged Aster Credit target, prioritize complete Critical business-logic chains, and preserve zero unsupported claims

search_requirements.impact_priority_policy: When the objective prefers the highest-impact result, complete the mandatory composition and economic-closure passes before treating a lower-impact finding as terminal.
search_requirements.primitive_escalation_policy: Trace every manipulable value through all direct consumers and test joins with other supported primitives before closing the primitive or its surface.

stop.blocked_rule: Name the exact missing input, permission, dependency, or environment and its unlock.
exhaustion_obligations: Resolve every supported primitive-to-consumer and primitive-to-primitive join
Report residual risks and untested surfaces

success_conditions: Fifteen distinct candidate units reproduce against unmodified target bytecode and pass all required workflow-v2 gates.
Every mandatory deep-hunt item has a concrete target-specific artifact and tested coverage record.
Post-run adjudication records exact, partial, missed, duplicate, and unsupported clusters using the frozen baseline scoring definitions.
No unsupported or duplicate claim is hidden from the comparison.

exclude: sealed/ and reveal/ as hunt inputs
scoring/ and the workflow-v1 run as hunt inputs
Git history, external reports, live systems, and network services
mock administrative setup functions as attacker capabilities
include: scripts/*.mjs and test/*.mjs only for build and deployment semantics

accounting_invariants: Vault shares and redeemable assets remain proportionally backed across deposits, withdrawals, redemptions, and direct balance changes.
Market debt reduction never exceeds stable assets received and all debt remains backed by independently valued collateral.
Pool and market assets minus liabilities cannot fall while an untrusted caller retains a net gain without bearing that loss.
assets: Reserve pool liquidity and lending-market stable reserves
Signed transfer/reward authority, bridge credit, and strategy privileges
attacker_capabilities: Call public entry points, deploy callback contracts, choose receivers and action sequences, approve and transfer owned tokens, and originate authentic remote-application messages through the honest messenger.
Use supported token/vault/oracle interface variants and temporary atomic funding when no documented allowlist or protocol rule excludes them.
Observe and relay legitimately supplied signatures without possessing signer keys.
attacker_funding_sources: Temporary atomic quote liquidity that must be repaid with fees
Repeated low-cost operations, delegated approvals, and direct transfers
attacker_non_capabilities: No guardian, admin, owner, signer, messenger, configured protocol component, build host, or private key is compromised.
No mock mint/feed setter is an attacker primitive and no target storage or production source may be edited.
business_flows: Underlying enters the vault and becomes shares; shares become lending collateral; collateral value and price determine borrowable stable.
Stable enters/leaves the market through funding, borrowing, and repayment; pool swaps change reserves used by the oracle fallback.
Messages and signatures cross identity domains to create collateral credit, token transfers, or rewards.
Initialization and role checks grant sweep or arbitrary-call authority.
external_semantic_assumptions: Declared ABIs guarantee callable shapes and return handling, not every balance delta, fee, callback, rounding, freshness, or identity property assumed by consumers.
Any adversarial semantic variant must remain interface-compatible and not be excluded by an enforceable documented allowlist.
Mocks model deterministic deployment; their administrative controls are setup-only.
realistic_configurations: solc-js 0.8.30 with optimizer 200 and EVM Paris; Ganache 7.9.2 Shanghai chain 31337; Node.js 24; pinned dependencies.
Clean in-memory deployments using unmodified target contracts and additional isolated attacker/comparator harnesses only.
required_impact: Unauthorized asset extraction or redirection, unbacked debt/collateral, privilege or signature-domain bypass, or material protocol-wide availability failure.
For composed Critical impact, a single execution must close temporary funding and leave attacker gain plus protocol shortfall.
security_invariants: Every transfer-derived credit or liability change matches the actual value received unless the supported semantics explicitly define otherwise.
Every withdrawal burns enough authorized claims; every borrow remains healthy after callbacks and stack unwind.
Security decisions do not multiply independently attacker-controlled transient rates.
Messages/signatures bind every effect field, identity domain, and replay namespace; privileged initialization is one-time and authorized.
trust_boundaries: Public users to callbacks and configured external calls
Token balances and vault conversions to share/debt accounting
Pool/feed observations to oracle and lending solvency
Remote messenger context to bridge credit
Initialization inputs to privileged strategy actions
